title: UE Trace Insights
description: Record bounded Unreal traces and query registered .utrace evidence through an Engine-matched offline TraceServices Worker.

recipes.title: Record and analyze an Editor, PIE, or Development trace
recipes.description: Resolve a bounded target and preset, record with explicit lifecycle evidence, then analyze only the target Region through semantic providers.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Editor, exact PIE session/generation, or versioned Development launch profile target.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.description: Versioned trace preset selected from live channel discovery.

inputs.name: queryRange
inputs.description: Optional bounded time range inside the recorded target Region.

steps.purpose: Resolve target, backend, preset channels, limits, and live availability before recording.
For Development only, resolve the versioned executable, hashes, map, fixed arguments, allowed CVars, bounds, and exact approval digest.
Start the bounded capture, observe lifecycle progress, stop it gracefully, and preserve partial trace/log evidence after a child crash.
Inspect recorded providers and query the marked target Region using bounded Timing, Counter, Log, Bookmark, and Region semantics.
Export normalized bounded query evidence and retrieve only the required job-owned artifacts.

result.summary: Bounded target trace with Engine-matched semantic query and export evidence.
evidence: Development launch plan digest when applicable
trace and job IDs, lifecycle phases, SHA-256, log, and partial status
PIE begin/end Region and Bookmark when applicable
bounded semantic query pages and normalized export artifact IDs
success: the recording target and preset were live and bounded
Development launch used the exact approved versioned profile
the trace finalized or retained explicit partial evidence after a crash
queries defaulted to the recorded target Region and were cursor bounded
missing providers remained explicit rather than silently changing backend

recipes.title: Analyze an existing trace without Unreal Editor
recipes.description: Register an allowed .utrace file, analyze it in the local Worker, query available providers, export normalized evidence, and optionally open the same file in Unreal Insights.

inputs.name: tracePath
inputs.description: Allowed local .utrace path to import into the Worker store.

inputs.name: providerQueries
inputs.description: Bounded provider queries with explicit ranges, filters, sorting, cursor, and limit.

steps.purpose: Read versioned trace channel and backend contracts without depending on a running Editor.
Copy and hash the allowed trace into the Worker store, then initialize bounded TraceServices analysis under the registered trace ID.
List recorded providers and query bounded Timing, Counter, Log, Bookmark, and Region evidence using stable pagination.
Query Memory, Loading, Network, Tasks, context switches, File IO, or embedded screenshots only when provider discovery reports the operation available.
Export normalized JSON/CSV and optionally open the matching Unreal Insights executable without mouse automation.

result.summary: Editor-independent trace registration and bounded provider evidence from the Engine-matched local Worker.
evidence: Worker, Engine, protocol, and contract handshake
bounded query range, filter, stable order, cursor, and limit
Insights path and viewApplied result when opened
success: no Unreal Editor process was required for import, query, or export
the trace and Worker Engine minor versions matched
the imported path satisfied the allowed-root policy
all event queries remained bounded and stable
unsupported providers returned explicit availability evidence
Unreal Insights visualization was not used as the structured-data backend

resources.description: Recording target, offline Worker, provider-query, path, version, and Insights visualization boundaries.
